parent_objective: run temporal-safe interpolation/projection over M1029 repair candidates before first replay
blocked_by: M1030 chooses temporal-safe projection before modifying exact_post_ppo_repair
invalidates: running first replay on temporal-failing M1029 endpoints

public_gates: M1031 must not use private holdout
M1031 must preserve P0 actor inputs
M997 temporal exact retention must pass before M297/M270/replay acceptance
M297/M270 exact no-regression must pass before replay
M267/M264 row15 and M183/M170 first replay must pass before any full public gate route
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run replay for temporal-failing alphas
do not promote any projection candidate

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo: temporal-safe projection before first replay
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether any bounded fraction of M1029 repair directions preserves M997 temporal exact while retaining enough exact repair movement
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-PPO projection diagnostic only; no promotion, no private holdout, no full public gate claim
stop_condition: stop if no alpha passes M997 temporal exact
stop if temporal-safe alphas lose M297/M270 exact no-regression
stop if selected temporal/exact candidate fails M267/M264 row15 or M183/M170 first replay
fallback_plan: if no temporal-safe alpha exists, design direct M997 objective integration
if temporal/exact passes but replay fails, route to objective coverage audit
if first replay passes, route to full public gate design

hypothesis: A bounded interpolation from Candidate B to one M1029 repair candidate can satisfy M997 temporal exact retention while preserving enough M297/M270 repair signal to justify first replay gates.
success_criteria: candidate checkpoints for evaluated alphas exist
at least one alpha passes M997 temporal exact and M297/M270 exact no-regression
selected candidate passes M267/M264 first replay with row15 retained
selected candidate passes M183/M170 first replay
no PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: no alpha passes M997 temporal exact
temporal-safe alphas fail M297/M270 exact no-regression
selected candidate fails M267/M264 row15 or M183/M170 first replay

commands.name: temporal_safe_projection_probe
commands.command: implement/run temporal-safe interpolation projection over M1029 candidates; write docs/m1031-v4-public-base-candidate-b-temporal-safe-projection-probe.md

decision_rule: M1031 can route to full public gate design only if M997 temporal exact, M297/M270 exact, M267/M264 row15, and M183/M170 first replay all pass without actor-input changes.
